sections.heading: Test Resolve
sections.body: When you Test Resolve, make a Reaction roll.

sections.heading: Virtue
sections.body: The following are in effect whenever you receive your Virtue Condition

subsections.heading: Stalwart [HOPE]
subsections.text: Whenever you make an Action roll in line with your Virtue, +1 Hope. If your Hope Slots are already full, give +1 Hope to an ally.

subsections.heading: Virtue [COURAGE]
subsections.text: Whenever you make an Action roll in line with your Virtue, +1 Courage. If your Courage Slots are already full, give +1 Courage to an ally.

sections.footer: Clear Virtuous at the end of rest or during travel.

sections.heading: Torment
sections.body: The following are in effect whenever you receive your Torment Condition

subsections.heading: Torment [HOPE]
subsections.text: You cannot gain Hope. Whenever you make an Action roll in accordance with your Torment, you may Test Resolve again.

subsections.heading: Torment [COURAGE]
subsections.text: You cannot gain Courage. Whenever you make an Action roll in accordance with your Torment, you may Test Resolve again.

sections.footer: Clear Tormented at the end of rest or during travel.
